semantics.normalized: x/y relative image width/height; z is predicted relative depth, not metric image depth
semantics.world: model-predicted meters, pose hip-centered and hand hand-centered; no calibrated camera/global trajectory
semantics.pose_visibility: raw returned likelihood visible, not a measured position accuracy
semantics.hand_visibility_presence: null means API does not supply per-joint confidence; handedness score is classification, not keypoint confidence
semantics.tracking: VIDEO mode uses official tracking; no identity guarantee or independent accuracy validation
